The '''Gungan Temples''' were [[monument|sizable structures]] that held special meaning to the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].<ref name="SW:GB" /> They were used to hold sacred staffs in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Jahai]] [[3000 BBY|three millennia]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="EA" /> [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] later built one to serve as as a rallying point for the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] after the [[Liberation of Harte Secur|liberation]] of [[Harte Secur]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="SW:GB" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> Gungan Temples required 3000 units each of [[Ore/Legends|ore]], [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], and [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] to construct, and were built by [[Glurrg]]s.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gungan Temples appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]]. In multiplayer, players can build monuments such as this one, and if defended for 200 in-game "days," can win the scenario. During the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] campaign's bonus mission, an alternate version of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Grassy Plains]], the objective is to destroy a Temple defended by the Gungan Grand Army.
